plan: Drive: from District of Kitimat, about 90 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.33123, -128.77721, pull off on Goat S Sp 2000 FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.8 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,180 m, about 255 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 140 m N of the spot at 67 m (53.2819, -128.71899). Water: Klekane River 40 m NE (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-3, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-16, closures 2026-10-16.
R6E-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-3: about 588 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
